page.title: Saray Konektor
page.intro: Ikonekta iray advertising account mo. Saray lead manlapud saray ads mo et automatikon onsabi ed My Leads, kaiba so gastos tan gastos ed kada lead.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form et mangitonton ed My Leads, inagew-agew a gastos tan gastos ed kada lead, tan say kalidad na lead ya ipawil ed LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Ag ni aka-set up ed sayan server

banner.connected: LinkedIn konektado. Saray lead et naala la natan - sayan pahina et na-update ed sakey a bekta.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn et agni aka-set up ed sayan server. Kaukolan ya idagdag na sakey ya administrador so client ID tan sekreto na LinkedIn app.
banner.expired: Say koneksyon LinkedIn et linmabas la, kanian saray lead et ag la man-sync. Ikonekta lamet pian makapantultuloy.
banner.reconnectSoon: Kaukolan ya man-sign in ka lamet LinkedIn antis na {{date}} . Ikonekta lamet antis pian mansiansian onaagus iray lead.

connect.title: Mankonekta LinkedIn
connect.intro: Man-sign in ed LinkedIn account ya mangaasikaso ed saray ads mo. Leadrat et manbabasa labat na saray ad account yo, saray lead Lead Gen Form tan saray estadistika na ad, tan mangipapawit na saray conversion ya in-switch on yo.
connect.need1: Sakey a papel ed LinkedIn ad account (Manbabantay o mas atagey ni).
connect.need2: Say papel ed aka-link ya pahina na kompanya (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator o Analyst) - Kaukolan na LinkedIn ya mangiter na saray lead.
connect.need3: Say tepet ed numero na telepono ed Lead Gen Forms yo - saray lead ya anggapoy numero na telepono et ag nayarin idagdag.

connection.title: Koneksyon
connection.autoRenews: Say access et automatikon man-renew anggad saman
connection.syncResult: Asumpal so pan-sync: {{received}} naawat, {{created}} ginawa, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} ag-inawat.
connection.confirmDisconnect: I-disconnect LinkedIn ? Ontunda so pan-sync tan nabura iray access token. Saray lead, statistics tan say activity log et natipon.
connection.noPermission: Sarag mon nengnengen iyan pahina. Say pangikonekta tan panguman na saray setting et kaukolan so "Manage Settings" ya permiso.
connection.fetchTitle: Mangala na saray lead unong ed petsa
connection.fetchHint: Saray balon lead et i-check kada pigaran minuto tan say unor ya 7 ya agew et i-re-check ed inagew-agew, kanian anggapoy nalingwanan. Usaren iya parad saray lead antis kan akakonekta, odino pian nanengneng lamet so sakey a peryodo (anggad 90 ya agew ed sakey a panaon). Saray lead ya wala lad Leadrat et ag la nalampasan.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} aromog, {{created}} ginawa, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} rejected, {{skipped}} ya in-import la.

accounts.none: Anggapoy naromog ya ad accounts parad sayan LinkedIn account. Nengnengen so papel na account ed LinkedIn Campaign Manager , insan i-refresh.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Ibagam LinkedIn no dinan ed saray lead to so nagmaliw ya peteg ya prospect. No say sakey a LinkedIn lead et akasabi ed status ya pinili yo ed leksab, ireport itan Leadrat ed LinkedIn , pian saray report na kampanya yo et mangipatnag na kalidad na lead tan LinkedIn et makaromog na mas dakel a totoon singa saray sankaabigan ya lead yo. Say LinkedIn lead ID tan say one-way hash labat na email so nipawit.
capi.noRules: Anggapo ni ray status ya aka-map.
capi.status: No onsabi so sakey a lead
capi.created: Say conversion et ginawa ed LinkedIn tan in-map.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Amin ya walad baetan Leadrat tan LinkedIn : saray koneksyon, kada pan-sync, kada lead tan no antoy agawa ed satan, saray conversion tan saray error.
